newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Budapest bourse suspends Goldsun for day.
newsitem.headline: Budapest bourse suspends Goldsun for day.

text.p: Trading in shares of frozen food company Goldsun Rt was suspended for the rest of the day after only a few deals due to too rapid an intraday rise, traders said on Monday.

Goldsun, which is under liquidation and recently has experienced hectic trading, was suspended after a rise of 140 forints or 53.85 percent from Friday's rise to 400 forints, prompting the bourse to suspend trading in it.
Under Budapest Stock Exchange rules a price change of more than 10 percent results in a few minutes halt in trading, while a change of more than 20 percent results in a suspension for the day.
